ttea.games.kartea.model.reflexivemodel

Common base of the KarTEA data models.

Gathers what used to be copied in each file of model/: the initialize_reflexive decorator (PROPERTIES and DATA_PROPERTIES) and the set_data/get_data methods.

Classes

ReflexiveModel

Mixin with set_data/get_data based on PROPERTIES.

Functions

initialize_reflexive

Fill the reflection class attributes of a dataclass.
initialize_reflexive(cls)[source]

Fill the reflection class attributes of a dataclass.

Parameters:
clstype

The dataclass to be decorated.

Returns:
type

The same class, with PROPERTIES and DATA_PROPERTIES filled.

Notes

  • PROPERTIES receives the names of all dataclass fields.

  • DATA_PROPERTIES receives the default value of each init field (dataclasses.MISSING when the field has none).

  • Must be applied above @dataclass, since it reads the fields created by it.

Examples

>>> from dataclasses import dataclass
>>> @initialize_reflexive
... @dataclass
... class Point(ReflexiveModel):
...     x: int
...     y: int = 0
>>> Point.PROPERTIES
['x', 'y']
>>> Point.DATA_PROPERTIES[1]
0
